lines.en: I beat my two wing edges forward.
My body is like a flat wing.
I flap up and down as if flying.
My tail trails behind me, very thin.
I pass through the shadow of a rock.
In cold water I swim more slowly.
I drift a stretch on the current.
I glide over your shadow.
I move in the colors of the seabed.
There are markings on my back.
I turn and head deeper.
My wing-edges ripple gently.
I swim along the slope of the sand.
I pass above the seagrass.
I settle to the sand and pause.
I lift off again and swim on.
In warm water my colors are brighter.

lines.zh: 我在浅滩和深水之间来回。
lines.en: I work between the shallows and the deep.

lines.zh: 我贴在沙里，几乎看不见。
lines.en: I lie in the sand, nearly invisible.
Only my tail sways gently.
Half buried, only my eyes show.

lines.zh: 海水从我背上升起细纹。
lines.en: Water ripples over my back.
I wait for small fish to come near.
My tail spine stands upright.
I ripple my wing-edges slowly.
Grains of sand settle on my back.
The water here is very still.
I listen to the sounds of the seabed.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在沙上很淡。
lines.en: My shadow on the sand is faint.
I lift my head slowly to look.
A small fish passes beside me.
Pressed into the sand. Hidden.
You are standing in the sand.
Do not step on me; I will sting.

lines.zh: 我一直在这儿，你没看见。
lines.en: I have been here all along; you did not see me.

lines.zh: 你的脚离我的尾巴很近。
lines.en: Your foot is very near my tail.
I do not sting on purpose to hurt.

lines.zh: 这水里的东西我都认得。
lines.en: I know everything in these waters.
Two steps back and it is fine.
My color is the same as the sand.

lines.zh: 你的脚印压着我的沙窝。
lines.en: Your footprints crush the hollow where I rest.
I can swim away slowly.
I spring up and shake off the sand.
One of my wing-edges bent.
I bury my wing edges in the sand.
A thread of red shows in the water.
Red blooms from my wound in the water.
I creep slowly along the bottom.
I hide in the reef's shadow.
My tail spine is bent.
I gasp, gills working fast.
The barb on my tail remains.
Something is sinking through the water.
I ripple slowly over.
The smell is not strong.

lines.zh: 你扔下来的东西砸到沙了。
lines.en: What you dropped struck the sand.
I circle halfway around the bait.
I need not eat, but I will come near.

lines.zh: 你把水搅浑了，沙都起来了。
lines.en: You've muddied the water — sand everywhere.
It has a sheen on it.
I try it. Not to my taste.
I drift slowly away.
You stepped on my wing-edge.
I spring up and raise a cloud of sand.
My spine nearly touched you.
I slide aside.
Sand settles on both of us.
Your boot flattens the sand surface.
I sink slowly back into the sand.
That was unpleasant.

lines.zh: 我趴在沙里，你踩到才疼。
lines.en: I lie in the sand; step on me and it hurts.
Step back so I can move.
We swim side by side over the sand.
Do not touch my tail.
The water on this flat is just right.
We circle the reef rock.
Two tails draw lines across the sand.
There are two shadows on the bottom.
We rise together to breathe.
Keep the big fish away.
We go slowly deeper.
Our traces remain in the sand.
I sweep it toward me with my wing-edge.
It weighs almost nothing in water.
I bury it in the sand of the sea floor.
Too big. I cannot hold it in my mouth.
It sank into a crack in the reef.
I fan at it twice.
My mouth is underneath; it is awkward.

lines.zh: 我把它顶到浅一点的地方。
lines.en: I nose it toward shallower water.
Sand has covered it.
I beat my wing edges and glide off.
A shadow slides across the sea bed.
I flatten myself to the sand.
It is passing over me.
Sand shifts below and my barb tenses.
All I need is to raise my tail.
A splash would give me away.
It does not see me in the sand.
I wait for it to come within a step.
This one takes no strength.
You are above me. Good.
I watch your feet from below.
The closer you come, the flatter I lie.
Sand settles on my back.
My tail spine is already raised.
Light on the surface dazzles me.
I wait for you to step down.
Your shadow falls on the sand.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把身子挪了一点。
lines.en: I shift myself slightly.
One more step and you are in.
If I stay still, you will not notice.
My tail whips and the spine strikes.
You snatched your foot back.
I lie very flat on the sand.
I spring up into your leg.
We churn the sand into a cloud.
I drop back into the sand and hide.
You leap away and water sprays.
My spine is not broken.
I slide slowly into deeper water.
You are still watching me.
I rise slowly out of the sand.
There is one more shadow under the water.
My wing-edges stir the sand.
The water temperature here is just right.
I circle once along the seabed.

lines.zh: 我身上的斑纹和沙一样。
lines.en: My markings match the sand.
I raise my tail spine slowly.
The light above is bright.
I settle beside the reef rock.
I know this flat well.
The heat in the water distresses me.
I land on the sand and my edges jolt.

lines.zh: 我本该在水里，可这里的水不对。
lines.en: I belong in water, yet this water is wrong.

lines.zh: 水被炸开，我被掀到一边。
lines.en: The water bursts and I am thrown aside.

lines.zh: 有东西扎穿了我的边翼。
lines.en: Something pierced my wing-edge.

lines.zh: 一股冷意让我的鳍僵住。
lines.en: A chill stiffens my fins.
This stretch of seabed is empty.

lines.zh: 雷打在水上，我浑身一缩。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the water and I clench.
I fall into a place with no water.
